caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain light beige background: an old-fashioned flat iron. The iron is rendered in fine detail using shades of gray and black, making it appear three-dimensional. The flat iron has a thick, curved handle with decorative ridges, attached at both ends to the iron’s body via two short, angled supports. The body of the iron is a thick, wedge-shaped form with rounded edges and a slightly textured surface. Near the lower left corner of the drawing, the names “George Spector” and “Julius Bellamy” are written in small, precise handwriting. There are no other objects, patterns, or colors present in the composition.
title: Flatiron
